name: SteamLite (Real Steam / VAC)
note: Self-contained clean-room Steam client for Bannerlator's Real-Steam (VAC) launch mode. Combined package; extracts to imagefs/opt/steamlite/. Bundles our GPL-3.0 agent (steam.exe, WinNative-derived; corresponding source: steamlite/agent-src/ in this repo) + the matched genuine Valve Steam client set (steamclient64/steamclient + tier0_s/vstdlib_s + Steam/Steam2, plus CommonFilesSteam/steamservice, build 2026-05-21) so the game connects to VAC-secured servers. At launch the agent logs into genuine Steam and securely LaunchApp's the game (-steam). v6 agent p5 (2026-09-05): launcher-chain awareness for EA (and similar third-party-client) titles - WN_STEAM_LAUNCH_CHAIN + WN_STEAM_CHAIN_WAIT_S: waits for the real game exe while the chain (Link2EA/EADesktop/EASteamProxy/ActivationUI) is alive and holds the Steam session across the stub exe's hand-off (one relaunch); device-proven with Need for Speed Payback online via EA Desktop. Env-gated: without WN_STEAM_LAUNCH_CHAIN the game watch is identical to v5, so VAC/secure launches (TF2, L4D2, CS:S) are unchanged. v5 agent p3b (2026-09-02): friends/chat relay armed only ~5s after the game process is running, friends_relay event, WN_STEAM_VAC=0 shortens the never-spawned fallback window to ~15s. v4 (2026-09-02): live app<->agent channel + optional in-game friends/chat relay + Steam-region CM seeding, all env-gated. v3: launcher-hand-off watch + no-insecure-fallback secure launch; unified achievement-unlock events into C:\\wn-achievement-events\\; honors WN_STEAM_APPINFO_WAIT_MS / WN_STEAM_SKIP_APPINFO. See NOTICE.md / SOURCE.txt / VALVE_COMPONENTS.txt inside the package. Credits: agent is a clean-room derivative of WinNative (GPL-3.0, https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/WinNative); built on the Winlator lineage (brunodev85/winlator, Pipetto-crypto/winlator).
